USER REQUEST
Can you suggest some fiction books written by Michael Crichton?

gpt-4o-mini.title: Dragon Teeth
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A historical novel set in the Wild West, exploring the rivalry between paleontologists during the fossil wars.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Micro
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A thrilling adventure that takes readers into the microscopic world, blending science with suspense.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Sphere
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A gripping science fiction novel by Michael Crichton, exploring the psychological impact of a mysterious alien sphere discovered on the ocean floor. The story delves into themes of fear, human psyche, and the unknown, blending suspense with thought-provoking ideas.

gemma2:9b.title: Timeline
gemma2:9b.explanation: A group of history students are transported back in time to medieval France in this thrilling adventure.

gemma2:9b.title: Jurassic Park
gemma2:9b.explanation: A thrilling science fiction novel by Michael Crichton, exploring the consequences of genetic engineering and the revival of dinosaurs in a theme park gone awry. The story delves into themes of chaos theory and the ethical implications of scientific advancement.

gemma2:9b.title: Congo: The Movie Storybook
gemma2:9b.explanation: Based on Michael Crichton's film, this storybook brings to life the thrilling adventure of an expedition into the heart of the Congo, blending elements of science fiction and suspense. It explores themes of exploration, danger, and the unknown in a richly imagined setting.

My picks are: "Dragon Teeth", "Micro", and "Pirate Latitudes".
